answer: Whisper-relay bond: each epoch a whisper starts at a knoll node and passes down a chain; each relay re-seals it within 30 seconds, locking 60 credits in the vault. The last relay mints a pearl, proof of distinct live operators. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 slots at 60 credits, 60,000 in locks against a 40,000 pool, and one operator cannot answer two whispers at once, so locks burn. An honest agent relays once for 60 and keeps its share.
